evidence.positive: Against the running build (demo-demo tenant, admin-staged patient or2987-fake-8d66cd8d... case 73723), POSTed real ~S04 syringe-label scans to /api/cds/medication-selection/{pmrn}/{caseId} as loopuser. '~S040069020901     00010005053741104AK1PbJ4' returned 200 with context.medicationIdentifier=m-propofol, ndc=0069020901, isScanned=true; the app log read 'Matched pattern : match_criteria_22 extracted ndc : 0069020901' and '... parsed to 0069020901 (using pattern: match_criteria_22) maps to ...medication=m-propofol'. Lowercase '~s04006902090100010005053960222WL7PbJ4' also resolved to m-propofol (the (?i) flag works), and '~S046050561300     00002005053750463AG1us8C\' resolved to m-ondansetron-iv. 'BWH1234567' and 'bwh1234567' both parsed via match_criteria_18 to 1234567 (404 only because demo has no 7-digit mapping, log: 'parsed to 1234567 (using pattern: match_criteria_18) but didn't map to a known medication'). evidence.negative: Uploaded a copy of the shipped demo CSV with match_criteria_18 and match_criteria_22 rewritten back to the JavaScript-style '/i' suffix to POST /api/admin/config-imports/ndc-patterns/upload as admin. Response was 500 'Failed to import NDC Patterns: NDC pattern match_criteria_18 uses JavaScript regex syntax; use a Java inline flag such as (?i)'; app log showed 'ConfigImportController : Failed to import ndc-patterns for tenant demo-demo' with the IllegalArgumentException, and ndc_patterns still held the fixed (?i) rows afterwards (import rolled back). Control: uploading the unmodified shipped CSV returned 200 recordCountBefore=30 recordCountAfter=30. Also: an unmapped ~S04 scan ('~S049999999999 ...') still parses via match_criteria_22 and returns 404 'ndc_not_found' rather than silently matching something else.
evidence.red_check: Two flips, both reverted. (1) Pre-fix code: compiled the parent commit's NDCPatternImporter (no syntax guard, @Slf4j replaced by an explicit logger) inside the container with the image's javac, backed up the shipped class (md5 a9c92ab5...), copied the pre-fix class (md5 b113903c...) over /app/classes/.../NDCPatternImporter.class and restarted the container. The same '/i' CSV upload then returned 200 recordCountAfter=30 and demo-demo.ndc_patterns now held '^(~S)?(04){1}(?<ndc>[\d]{10})(.*)$/i' and '((^(BWH){1})(?<ndc>(\d{7})))/i' — the guard's absence went red. Restored the shipped class from the backup (md5 matched a9c92ab5... again) and restarted. (2) Data flip: with the fixed code running against that stale broken row (cache cold after restart, the exact state the ticket describes in production), the propofol scan returned 404 and the log read '~S040069020901     00010005053741104AK1PbJ4 did not match any NDC patterns' (BWH1234567 likewise). Reverted by uploading the shipped CSV through the restored importer (200), confirmed the (?i) rows were back, restarted, and the propofol scan returned 200 m-propofol again. Finally simulated the deploy path: set match_criteria_22 back to the '/i' form by SQL, deleted the imported_resources checksum row, restarted; the startup importer logged 'Importing: class path resource [data/org/demo/ndc-patterns/ndc-patterns.csv]' / 'imported ndc-patterns.csv', the row returned to the (?i) form at its original rank 26, and the scan resolved to propofol. Container /tmp scratch removed; shipped class checksum verified after every restore.

caveats: Scans were injected through POST /api/cds/medication-selection (the endpoint the scanner UI calls), not through a physical 2D scanner or the browser scan page; the OR 41/42 hardware path was not exercised.
Only the demo-demo tenant was exercised at runtime; the mayo and mgb CSVs carry the identical two-line fix and are covered by NDCPatternConfigTest, but their DB rows were not scanned against here.

The ticket's propofol/antibiotic/sugammadex labels from the Slack thread were not available; the sample ~S04 and BWH scans from NDCPatternConfigTest were used instead, with propofol and ondansetron mappings present in demo.

Production environments holding the broken rows are fixed by the startup re-import when the CSV checksum changes on deploy; that path was simulated here by deleting the checksum row rather than observed on a real upgraded database.

automation.assessment: NDCPatternConfigTest already imports each org's shipped CSV and asserts real ~S04/BWH scans resolve, and NDCPatternImporterSyntaxTest covers the guard at unit level. What is not covered is the integrated path: patterns read from the tenant DB by the running app and the admin upload endpoint refusing a bad CSV. Both are cheap API-level qa-suite tests in the scanner NDC family and are worth locking in as supplemental.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: Real ~S04 syringe-label and BWH scans posted to the medication-selection endpoint on the demo tenant resolved through match_criteria_22 and match_criteria_18, with the propofol label returning m-propofol / NDC 0069020901 and the lowercase variant resolving too.
Negative: Uploading an NDC pattern CSV with the old JavaScript-style /i suffix through the admin config import was rejected with a 500 naming the bad label, and the stored patterns were left untouched.
Red check: With the pre-fix importer class swapped into the container the same bad CSV was accepted, and the fixed app then logged that the propofol label did not match any NDC patterns and returned 404; the class and data were restored and the scan resolved again, and a simulated deploy re-import replaced a stale broken row.

Automation: Three supplemental scanner-family API tests are proposed covering the ~S04 scan, its lowercase form, and the admin upload rejection.
